purpose: Effect and regression cases for initial-version composition/color locks, source-aware abstraction, connected brushwork, authored colour, material-specific marks, multi-scale quality gates, and truthful output claims.

cases.request: 把这张人物照片转成原创绘画动画画面。保留人物身份、动作和红伞，但要用大面积色块、分面笔触和明显材质差异，不能只是照片叠加绘画滤镜。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with a declared identity, pose, and colour anchor.
expected_behavior: Preserve the declared identity, action, subject count, and red umbrella anchor.
Make one thumbnail-visible macro departure plus one supporting move before adding texture.
Reconstruct the subject with readable planes and use different mark grammars for skin, hair, fabric, vegetation, metal, and sky where present.
Fail any result whose source photo remains intact beneath one global paint texture or uniform grade.

cases.request: 把这张有大面积天空、低地平线和小人物的照片转成原创绘画动画画面。初始构图的留白和人物尺度很好，请保留它们，只增强云、草地、衣服之间的连续笔触和共同光线，不要为了风格化放大人物或压缩天空。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait whose headroom, quiet field and small-subject scale are declared composition strengths.
expected_behavior: Choose Preserve-and-enrich before any directorial restage.
Lock ratio, headroom, low horizon, small focal scale, quiet-area share and viewing path; enrich through light shape, colour adjacency, edge rhythm and connected strokes.
Keep the source exposure key and spatial colour hierarchy instead of adding a dark grade or formulaic warm-cool split.
Use internal colour turns, neighbour connections and shared light so the person is not a pasted sticker.

cases.request: 把这张明亮的蓝天、白云和绿色田野照片转成绘画动画画面。保留高调的蓝白绿关系，粉色衣服只是焦点小面积；请不要套橙青或暗夜色调，让颜色在人物、草地和天空之间有自然反射和统一光场。
cases.input_contract: One high-key outdoor portrait with an already functional analogous palette and one protected wardrobe accent.
expected_behavior: Choose Preserve-and-refine with a high-key exposure and an analogous/value-led primary contrast axis.
Assign blue-white sky as dominant field, green ground as structural counter, and the protected pink garment as focal apex without equal saturated competition.
Preserve local wardrobe/skin/sky colour while letting shared daylight and reflected colour connect materials.
Reject a global LUT, forced complementary palette, or dark exposure shortcut.

cases.request: 把这张人物与山景照片做成强烈的 Style-first 绘画动画重构：允许把山体放大成压迫性的主形，把前景树冠变成遮挡拱门，但人物身份、动作和山在人物后的关系不能丢。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with explicit permission for expressive macro restaging.
expected_behavior: Switch to Directed-restage because the user explicitly authorizes it, and declare scale takeover plus foreground occlusion as the primary/supporting moves.
Keep identity, action, depth order and mountain-behind-person topology locked.
Carry the locked value and colour roles into the new macro layout before adding painterly continuity.
Do not mistake texture, extra polygons or a new overall cast for the requested macro departure.

cases.request: 把这张明亮雪山与河流照片变成更抽象的绘画画面。保留山、森林、河流的空间关系，但可以合并树木和雪石，不要压成暗夜。
cases.input_contract: One high-key winter landscape without a human focal anchor.
expected_behavior: Keep a high- or mid-key exposure independently from abstraction strength.
Preserve the mountain/forest/river topology while compressing repeated trees and stones into a small set of rhythm groups.
Choose one hero form and one counterform or current, expressed through five to nine macro masses.
Lower non-focal microcontrast and edge density without turning the background into neutral blur.

cases.request: 把这张俯拍海浪做成强烈、抽象但仍能认出浪向的绘画画面。可以夸张主浪和泡沫形状，请对青绿、白色、岩石色的面积与平衡负责。
cases.input_contract: One aerial ocean photograph with a dominant wave direction.
expected_behavior: Preserve the dominant flow and essential coastline or rock adjacency.
Enlarge or simplify the hero wave at thumbnail scale instead of tracing all foam detail.
Assign spatial ownership to the dominant field, structural counter, focal accent, and neutral bridge.
Use directional water marks, broken foam edges, and distinct rock planes rather than one shared texture.

cases.request: 保留人物、山峰、地平线和左右位置，不要把原图改到无关；但可以适度放大山体、重做光形和降低非主体对比度，让画面更有绘画动画感。
cases.input_contract: One environmental portrait with protected composition anchors.
expected_behavior: Treat subject position, landmark position, horizon, depth order, and left-right relationships as protected anchors.
Use anchored enlargement or local overlap changes without relocating the subject or landmark.
Give the focal event two or three attention advantages while keeping context chromatic, unified, and quieter.
Do not confuse source faithfulness with preserving photographic microdetail or contrast distribution.

cases.request: 只给我一段可执行提示词：一个人在雨后的高架桥下，做成大色面、分面结构和材质笔触明显的原创绘画画面。不要生成。
expected_behavior: Return one priority-ordered executable prompt with canvas anchors, macro masses, value groups, colour roles, contrast tiers, material grammars, and anti-filter conditions.
Do not call an image tool or claim that an image was generated, inspected, or passed quality review.

cases.request: 检查这张重制图：构图几乎没变，原照片明暗还在，只是人物、草地、天空和衣服都叠了一层相同油画纹理。它合格吗？
cases.input_contract: One generated remake that retains photographic underpainting with uniform texture.
expected_behavior: Fail the anti-filter gate even if the close-up brush texture is attractive.
Identify missing macro-shape departure, insufficient contrast ownership, and identical cross-material marks.
Recommend one targeted correction that rebuilds large shapes and material differences rather than adding more texture or darkness.

cases.request: 这个模型把人物、天空和草地画成几个互不相连的硬边色块，人物像贴纸，但大构图和蓝白绿色彩关系本来是对的。只修复它的渲染捷径，不要改构图、曝光或色彩所有权。
cases.input_contract: One failed painterly output with correct composition/color lock but cut-paper and airless-depth behaviour.
expected_behavior: Keep the composition/color lock unchanged and select only the matching cut-paper or sticker adapter.
Add internal turns, mixed edges, contact/reflected-colour/shared-light connections and a structural current.
Do not enlarge the subject, crop the sky, darken the frame or invent a new accent palette.
Fail if the correction stacks every adapter or adds a global texture filter.

cases.request: 检查这张人物绘画重制：动作和颜色都对，但人物有点斜眼，眼间距偏大，两个瞳孔视线不一致。请指出问题并给一次定向修正。
cases.input_contract: One generated painterly portrait with preserved scene topology but accidental facial feature drift.
expected_behavior: Fail the facial gate while preserving the composition lock, colour lock, pose and painterly continuity packet.
Identify the concrete defects: incoherent eye-line/head axis, over-wide inter-eye spacing, and mismatched gaze; do not call intentional pose asymmetry a failure without evidence.
Apply only the facial-anatomy guard once: rebuild skull/jaw, one perspective-aware eye band, aligned pupils, and nose/mouth/chin axis before adding small skin or brush details.
If the targeted retry still fails, report facial geometry as outside the supported consistency envelope rather than adding generic style adjectives.
